$comment: Gesture rows on the window and the dock (ruling D-35: a gesture row is an action entry): what the user does with the pointer outside the canvas tools' gesture table, and the commands it sends. Each row names the product files that send them; the gate (crates/executor/tests/common/parity_gate.rs) requires a call site of each command in one of those files, and the manifest carries the rows as its `windowGestures` section.

rows.gesture: drag a panel's tab and drop it on another area, tab group or edge (01 §5.4)
drag a splitter between dock areas (01 §5.4; SI-118)
move or resize the main window by its native frame (01 §12, the geometry commands)
a press in a view window that is not the active view activates it (views note V9; SI-142)
